messages:
meera.k: Heads up — changelog cutoff tomorrow 18:00 PDT for the v0.9.1 SDK/docs/sampleapp bundle. Please flag anything you absolutely need in.
jordyn: quick q — are sample apps included in the same changelog entry or separate per language?
meera.k: separate entries per language + one umbrella 'sample apps' note. We want clear upgrade steps for each SDK.
sam.t: @meera.k I still need a doc blurb for the Go quickstart — working on it, ETA EOD today. CC @docs-ptl for review.
docs-ptl: thanks @sam.t — if you paste the snippet here I can do a quick edit. Prefer <=3 steps and a full command example.
jordyn: tagging owners: sample-java -> @sasha, sample-python -> @jordyn, sample-go -> @sam.t. Anyone else?
sasha: got it. python sample had a transitive dep issue with grpc 1.58 — fixed in draft PR but needs a reviewer. @meera.k is code review prioritized for changelog cutoff?
meera.k: prioritize the SDK stability fixes and any doc mismatches. Sample feature additions can go to the next patch unless they unblock QA.
sasha: noted. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/482 — reviewer request to @jordyn and @sam.t. CI shows one flaky test in ci/integration/test_embed.py
sam.t: I'll take a look after stand. If flaky test is just timing, add a retry and note in changelog under 'known issues'.
release-bot: [auto] changelog-cutoff-reminder: v0.9.1 cutoff in ~20 hours.
jordyn: dependency check — platform infra team warned earlier that the hosted runtime toggles for caching will land before release. Does that affect any quickstart instructions?
meera.k: good catch. Docs should not mention 'auto-prefix cache' until the toggle is live. Add a note: "cache behavior may vary by deployment; see runtime toggles" with link once live.
docs-ptl: I'll redact the cache wording and add an inline footnote. Sam, can you include the CLI commands you want in the quickstart? e.g.
```
# build and run python sample
pip install -r requirements.txt
python samples/quickstart.py --model redwood/latest
```
meera.k: also need owner for changelog PR itself. Suggest @jordyn to shepherd the changelog draft and @meera.k to approve.
jordyn: I can assemble the draft. Please drop bullet points (1-2 lines) in the changelog thread by 16:00 PDT tomorrow.
sasha: FYI sample-java is blocked on a transitive license check (third-party legal) — might be delayed past cutoff. If so we'll omit Java entry and add an "upcoming" note.
meera.k: decision: if legal blocks persist by 15:00 PDT tomorrow, omit java and file a follow-up. Please ping me if it looks tight.
sam.t: pinging in case of reviewer delays — if either of you can't review by noon I can do a triage pass and land a minimal fix.
jordyn: ack. I'll prioritize changelog assembly and the review for the PRs I own.
sasha: leaving a short checklist in the PR: deps verified, tests green, doc snippet included, changelog bullet.
meera.k: perfect. final ask: if you depend on any infra flags (caching/runtime toggle), add a one-liner in the PR explaining the dependency so release engineering can coordinate rollout.
sam.t: will do. thanks folks — will post the Go blurb in 2h.
jordyn: thanks all.
release-bot: [auto] noted: changelog-draft-created by jordyn (placeholder)
meera.k: closing loop — if no major surprises we'll ship the bundle. If anything critical pops up, create an incident thread and tag @meera.k + @release-bot.
